verdict.rationale: Durable workflows are a fair axis for a compute platform, but the evidence pack shows no first-party workflow-as-code engine with built-in step durability, queuing or retries. Machine restart policies, Sprite checkpoints and raw VMs are building blocks and adjacent features that a developer would still have to wire into a workflow system themselves.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries
